units.source_text: 此外，小時候我在繪本上看過地鐵，

en.t: Also, when I was a child, I saw a subway in a picture book,

units.source_text: 一直認為那不是為了實用而建造，

en.t: and I always thought it had not been built for practical use,

units.source_text: 而是由於一個好玩的目的——比起在地面上坐車，

en.t: but rather for the amusing purpose that, compared with riding on the surface,

units.source_text: 地下的車更別出心裁、更有趣。

en.t: a vehicle underground was more original and more interesting.

units.source_text: 我從小就體弱多病，常臥床不起。

en.t: From childhood I was frail and sickly, and often had to stay in bed.

units.source_text: 我常常躺在床上，想床單、枕套、被套這些單調乏味的裝飾品。

en.t: I would often lie in bed and think of sheets, pillowcases, and quilt covers as dull, tedious decorations.

units.source_text: 直到快二十歲時，才突然明白，這些都是生活中很必要的實用品，

en.t: Only when I was nearly twenty did I suddenly realize that these were all very necessary practical things in life,

units.source_text: 於是，不禁為人類的儉樸而悲從中來。

en.t: and then I could not help feeling sorrow at human frugality.

units.source_text: 還有，我不知道飢餓的滋味是什麼。

en.t: Also, I did not know what hunger felt like.

units.source_text: 這並不意味著我出生在衣食無憂的家庭，

en.t: This does not mean that I was born into a family free from worries about food and clothing,
nor am I foolish enough to mean anything like that,

units.source_text: 只是真的對飢餓感毫無知覺。

en.t: only that I truly had no awareness of the sensation of hunger.
